title: PHP object injection through unserialize() on untrusted input
root_cause: Untrusted data is passed to unserialize() without an options array restricting allowed_classes. Any autoloadable class can be instantiated, so a magic method chain (__wakeup / __destruct / __toString) can be leveraged into remote code execution.

origin.reference: CLAUDE.md section 4 (Insecure Deserialization & Remote Code Execution)
origin.note: No advisory in the local knowledge store is classified as DESERIALIZATION. This pair documents the contract of InsecureDeserializationRule and is not tied to a published advisory.
